name: Law of Focal Point
axiom: One mark with the most contrast takes the eye, and everything else waits its turn.
trigger: Every plan in a pricing table has a solid red Buy button, so none stands out.

checklist.text: Give one action per view the strongest fill, and demote the rest to outline.
Allow one high-contrast badge per screen; a second cancels the first.
Put the recommended option in one accent border rather than five coloured buttons.
Screenshot the view, blur it, and see which element survives; it should be the action.

antiPattern.violation: Four pricing cards each carry an identical solid red Buy button, so no tier is focal.
antiPattern.remediation: Three tiers use outline buttons; the recommended one is framed and filled.
